text: Mbela Allah siforaali yonugol jeyaaɗo Makko on Muhammadu (yo o his) ka fiyakuuji makko diina e aduna, O duñana mo ayɓe makko? Pellet, O yonay mo. Hiɓe hulɓinire, an Nulaaɗo, sabu majjere e ɗaayre maɓɓe, ɗin sanamuuji, ɗi ɓe rewata ɓe acca Allah, wiide ɗi memirte bone. Kala non mo Allah hoyni, O hawrinaani mo fewnude, haray fewnoowo on ɗon, alaa.
